+# MoE token dedup and co-activation expert placement (Megatron)
+
+Port of ROCm/Megatron-LM [PR #165](https://github.com/ROCm/Megatron-LM/pull/165)
+(`--moe-token-dedup`) and [PR #166](https://github.com/ROCm/Megatron-LM/pull/166)
+(`--moe-expert-placement`) as Primus patches over the Megatron-core v0.19
+all-to-all token dispatcher. `third_party/Megatron-LM` is not modified.
+
+## What it does
+
+With top-k routing a token often selects several experts that live on the same
+expert-parallel (EP) rank. The stock all-to-all dispatcher still sends one hidden
+row per (token, expert) assignment.
+
+* **Token dedup** (`moe_token_dedup: true`) sends one All-to-All row per unique
+  (token, destination EP rank). The row carries the token's local expert ids and
+  routing weights, the receiver fans it out into expert-major order, and the
+  combine direction is deduplicated the same way (local expert outputs for one
+  wire row are summed before the combine All-to-All). Routing and the rows each
+  expert computes are unchanged. At EP=1 it silently falls back to the stock
+  dispatcher.
+* **Co-activation expert placement** (`moe_expert_placement: <json>`) reorders
+  which global expert lives on which EP rank (globally or per layer) so experts
+  that are often selected together share a rank, which gives dedup fewer wire
+  rows per token. Checkpoints stay keyed by global expert id, so any placement
+  loads from any `torch_dist` checkpoint.
+
+Measured on Qwen3-30B-A3B (TP1 EP8, seq 4096, GBS 128, 8x MI300X, resumed from a
+2000-iteration checkpoint, ROCm Megatron-LM base): dedup alone cuts All-to-All
+rows per token from 8.0 to 5.3 and step time by 3.6 to 4.0%; dedup plus the
+co-activation placement cuts rows to 4.5 and step time by 4.9 to 5.9%.
+
+## Configuration
+
+```yaml
+moe_token_dispatcher_type: alltoall   # required
+use_turbo_deepep: false               # DeepEP switches to the 'flex' dispatcher
+turbo_sync_free_moe_stage: 0
+moe_token_dedup: true
+moe_token_dedup_weighted_combine: false
+moe_expert_placement: /path/to/placement.json   # optional
+```
+
+Constraints (validated at `build_args`): all-to-all dispatcher, dropless routing
+(no `moe_expert_capacity_factor` / `moe_pad_expert_input_to_capacity` /
+`moe_router_padding_for_quantization`), `expert_tensor_parallel_size: 1`, no
+CUDA graphs, at most 256 local experts, and neither `use_turbo_mega_moe` nor the
+deprecated 20241209 MoE layer. Primus-Turbo attention and the Turbo grouped
+GEMM are compatible.
+
+`moe_token_dedup_weighted_combine: true` applies the routing weights in the
+dedup combine's reduce kernel instead of inside the experts; the experts then
+run with unit weights (Primus keeps the expert MLPs untouched, so the multiply
+by ones remains). It is numerically equivalent and off by default.
+
+See `examples/megatron/configs/MI300X/qwen3_30B_A3B-BF16-pretrain-token_dedup.yaml`.
+
+## Building a placement
+
+1. Capture routes with the stock routing (dedup may be on or off). The capture
+   is env-var gated:
+
+   ```bash
+   CMOE_CAPTURE=1 CMOE_CAPTURE_DIR=/scratch/routes CMOE_CAPTURE_START=2001 \
+   CMOE_CAPTURE_CONS_ITERS=8 ./runner/primus-cli direct -- train pretrain --config <exp.yaml>
+   ```
+
+   Each rank writes one `iter_<it>_mb<k>_rank<r>.pt` shard per micro-batch with
+   the per-token top-k expert ids and gate weights of every MoE layer.
+   `CMOE_CAPTURE_INTERVAL`, `CMOE_CAPTURE_NUM_RANKS`, `CMOE_CAPTURE_MAX_MB` and
+   `CMOE_CAPTURE_VERBOSE` are documented in
+   `primus/backends/megatron/core/capture.py`.
+
+2. Build the placement (Kernighan-Lin partition of the per-layer co-activation
+   matrix; `--nodes` additionally groups ranks per node):
+
+   ```bash
+   python tools/moe_expert_placement/build_expert_placement.py /scratch/routes \
+       --iters 2001-2008 --num-experts 128 --ep-size 8 --out placement.json
+   python tools/moe_expert_placement/inspect_expert_capture.py /scratch/routes   # optional
+   ```
+
+3. Train with `moe_expert_placement: placement.json`. A placement names EP ranks,
+   so it is specific to the EP size it was built for. Distributed-optimizer state
+   is restored by buffer position, not by global expert id: when resuming a
+   checkpoint saved under a different placement set `no_load_optim: true`
+   (`load_checkpoint` prints a warning otherwise). Legacy `torch`-format
+   checkpoints are refused under a different placement.
+
+## Implementation
+
+| Patch | Phase | Purpose |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `megatron.moe.token_dedup_args` | `build_args` | Validates the options and the placement JSON (the table is loaded from the path again at `before_train`). |
+| `megatron.moe.token_dedup` | `before_train` | Exposes the options on `TransformerConfig`, binds `PrimusAlltoAllTokenDispatcher` / `PrimusDedupAlltoAllTokenDispatcher` in place of `MoEAlltoAllTokenDispatcher`, resolves the per-layer placement in `BaseMoELayer.__init__` / `set_layer_number`. |
+| `megatron.moe.token_dedup_experts_probs` | `before_train` | Lets the expert MLPs accept `permuted_probs=None` (weighted combine only). |
+| `megatron.moe.expert_placement_checkpoint` | `before_train` | Keys the distributed-checkpoint expert axis by the placed global id (`TEGroupedMLP`, `SequentialMLP`, `TEGroupedLinear`, hence also `PrimusTurboGroupedLinear`); guards `load_checkpoint`. |
+| `megatron.moe.route_capture` | `before_train` | `CMOE_CAPTURE=1`: wraps `GPTModel.forward` and `TopKRouter.forward` to record routes. |
+
+Code: `primus/backends/megatron/core/transformer/moe/token_dedup.py` (Triton
+kernels and autograd functions, unchanged from the PR),
+`token_dedup_dispatcher.py` (the dispatcher subclasses), `expert_placement.py`
+(placement resolution and parsing), `primus/backends/megatron/core/capture.py`.
+Tests: `tests/unit_tests/megatron/moe/test_token_dedup.py` (CPU kernel and
+placement tests; EP parity tests on 2 to 8 GPUs).

+exp_name: ${PRIMUS_EXP_NAME:qwen3_30B_A3B-pretrain-token_dedup}
+workspace: ${PRIMUS_WORKSPACE:./output}
+
+# Qwen3-30B-A3B pretraining with MoE token dedup and (optionally) a co-activation
+# expert placement (ROCm/Megatron-LM PR #165 / #166 port). Both need the Megatron
+# all-to-all dispatcher, so DeepEP and the sync-free MoE path are off here.
+#
+#   1. capture routes:   CMOE_CAPTURE=1 CMOE_CAPTURE_DIR=<dir> CMOE_CAPTURE_START=<it> \
+#                        CMOE_CAPTURE_CONS_ITERS=8  <this config, moe_token_dedup off>
+#   2. build placement:  python tools/moe_expert_placement/build_expert_placement.py <dir> \
+#                        --iters <it>-<it+7> --num-experts 128 --ep-size 8 --out placement.json
+#   3. train:            PRIMUS_MOE_EXPERT_PLACEMENT=placement.json <this config>
+
+modules:
+  pre_trainer:
+    framework: megatron
+    config: pre_trainer.yaml
+    model: ${PRIMUS_MODEL:qwen3_30B_A3B}.yaml
+    overrides:
+      wandb_project: "Primus_Qwen3_30B_A3B_Pretrain"
+      stderr_sink_level: DEBUG
+
+      moe_router_force_load_balancing: false
+
+      log_avg_skip_iterations: 2
+      log_avg_reset_interval: 50
+
+      train_iters: ${PRIMUS_TRAIN_ITERS:50}
+      micro_batch_size: 1
+      global_batch_size: 128
+      seq_length: ${PRIMUS_SEQ_LENGTH:4096}
+      max_position_embeddings: ${PRIMUS_MAX_POSITION_EMBEDDINGS:4096}
+      lr: 1.0e-4
+      min_lr: 1.0e-5
+      lr_warmup_iters: 200
+      lr_decay_iters: 20000
+      lr_decay_style: cosine
+      weight_decay: 0.1
+      adam_beta1: 0.9
+      adam_beta2: 0.95
+      eod_mask_loss: true
+      init_method_std: 0.008
+      norm_epsilon: 1.0e-6
+
+      # parallel
+      tensor_model_parallel_size: ${PRIMUS_TP:1}
+      pipeline_model_parallel_size: ${PRIMUS_PP:1}
+      expert_model_parallel_size: ${PRIMUS_EP:8}
+      expert_tensor_parallel_size: 1
+      overlap_grad_reduce: true
+      overlap_param_gather: true
+
+      # data
+      mock_data: ${PRIMUS_MOCK_DATA:true}
+      train_data_path: ${PRIMUS_TOKENIZED_DATA_PATH:null}
+      valid_data_path: null
+      test_data_path: null
+
+      # fusion
+      gradient_accumulation_fusion: true
+
+      # ckpt
+      finetune: false
+      auto_continue_train: false
+      load: ${PRIMUS_LOAD:null}
+      no_load_optim: ${PRIMUS_NO_LOAD_OPTIM:null}
+      no_load_rng: null
+      save: ${PRIMUS_SAVE:null}
+      save_interval: 500
+      no_save_optim: null
+      no_save_rng: null
+      disable_last_saving: true
+      ckpt_format: torch_dist
+      eval_iters: 0
+
+      # MoE: all-to-all dispatcher, dropless routing (required by token dedup)
+      moe_token_dispatcher_type: alltoall
+      moe_permute_fusion: false
+      moe_grouped_gemm: true
+      moe_shared_expert_overlap: false
+      moe_router_dtype: fp32
+
+      # Token dedup / expert placement (PR #165 / #166)
+      moe_token_dedup: ${PRIMUS_MOE_TOKEN_DEDUP:true}
+      moe_token_dedup_weighted_combine: false
+      moe_expert_placement: ${PRIMUS_MOE_EXPERT_PLACEMENT:null}

+###############################################################################

+#
+# Ported unchanged from ROCm/Megatron-LM PR #166 (megatron/core/capture.py).
+###############################################################################
+"""Lightweight, env-var gated expert-affinity / route capture.
+
+Adapted from the Zyphra Megatron ``megatron/core/models/cmoe/capture.py``
+(commit f3143a62 "Expert affinity") for the standard MCore GPT + MoE path.
+
+This module provides a process-global :class:`CaptureManager` that records
+per-iteration routing information (and optionally token ids / input
+embeddings) during a forward pass and dumps it to disk.
+
+It is intended for analysis runs (e.g. "which expert path does each token in
+the sequence take?", from which the expert co-activation / affinity matrix is
+built). When disabled (the default) every entry point is a cheap attribute
+read, so it is safe to leave the instrumentation in the model.
+
+Everything is controlled by environment variables so it can be toggled from a
+launch script with no code / arg changes:
+
+    CMOE_CAPTURE            master switch (1/true to enable; default off)
+    CMOE_CAPTURE_EXPERTS    capture expert_paths + routing_probs (default on
+                            when master switch is on)
+    CMOE_CAPTURE_TOKENS     capture token_ids                    (default on)
+    CMOE_CAPTURE_EMBEDDINGS capture input_embeddings             (default off,
+                            this one is the memory-heavy stream)
+    CMOE_CAPTURE_DIR        output directory (default ./cmoe_capture)
+    CMOE_CAPTURE_START      first iteration to capture            (default 0)
+    CMOE_CAPTURE_CONS_ITERS consecutive iterations to capture per window, from
+                            START (default 0 = unlimited).
+    CMOE_CAPTURE_INTERVAL   spacing (iters) between window starts (default 0 =
+                            single window then stop; >0 repeats the window)
+    CMOE_CAPTURE_NUM_RANKS  capture only global ranks 0..N-1 (default 0 = all
+                            ranks). N ranks => N/world_size of samples per iter.
+    CMOE_CAPTURE_VERBOSE    print one line per captured iteration on rank 0
+                            (default off)
+
+The on-disk layout is byte-for-byte compatible with the ds_v3_routing /
+``inspect_routing.py`` captures, so the same downstream tooling reads both.
+
+Output filename: every shard is written as
+``{dir}/iter_{iteration:08d}_mb{mb}_rank{rank}.pt`` (including rank0/mb0), so all
+files for an iteration are named uniformly and easy to enumerate. The
+``inspect_routing`` consumers key off the in-file payload, not the filename, so
+they still read these directly.
+
+Each file is a dict matching the inspect_routing layout:
+
+    {
+      "iteration":          int,
+      "token_ids":          Tensor[b, s]               int32   (if enabled)
+      "input_embeddings":   Tensor[b, s, h]            bf16    (if enabled)
+      "moe_layer_indices":  list[int]   length L_moe
+      "expert_paths":       Tensor[b, s, L_moe, top_k] uint8   (ids 0..num_experts-1)
+      "routing_probs":      Tensor[b, s, L_moe, top_k] <native> (bf16 under --bf16)
+      # extra metadata (ignored by inspect_routing consumers):
+      "micro_batch":        int,
+      "parallel": {tp_rank, tp_size, cp_rank, cp_size, pp_rank, pp_size,
+                   ep_rank, ep_size, dp_rank, global_rank},
+    }
+
+Note on sharding: under context-parallel or sequence-parallel, the sequence
+dimension is split across ranks, so each rank's file holds only its local slice
+of the sequence. Use the ``parallel`` metadata to reassemble offline. Under
+pipeline parallelism each stage only holds a subset of MoE layers, so
+``moe_layer_indices`` differs per pp rank. Under virtual pipeline parallelism
+each model chunk's forward is a separate ``micro_batch`` shard.
+"""
+
+import os
+
+import torch
+
+
+def _env_flag(name: str, default: bool = False) -> bool:
+    val = os.environ.get(name)
+    if val is None:
+        return default
+    return val.strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "yes", "on")
+
+
+def _env_int(name: str, default: int) -> int:
+    val = os.environ.get(name)
+    if val is None or val.strip() == "":
+        return default
+    try:
+        return int(val)
+    except ValueError:
+        return default
+
+
+class CaptureManager:
+    """Process-global capture state. Access via :func:`get_capturer`."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.enabled = _env_flag("CMOE_CAPTURE", False)
+
+        # Per-stream switches (only meaningful when master switch is on).
+        self.capture_experts = self.enabled and _env_flag("CMOE_CAPTURE_EXPERTS", True)
+        self.capture_tokens = self.enabled and _env_flag("CMOE_CAPTURE_TOKENS", True)
+        self.capture_embeddings = self.enabled and _env_flag("CMOE_CAPTURE_EMBEDDINGS", False)
+
+        self.out_dir = os.environ.get("CMOE_CAPTURE_DIR", "./cmoe_capture")
+        self.start_iter = _env_int("CMOE_CAPTURE_START", 0)
+        # How many CONSECUTIVE iterations to capture per window, starting at
+        # START. 0 == unlimited (capture every iter from START onwards).
+        self.cons_iters = _env_int("CMOE_CAPTURE_CONS_ITERS", 0)
+        # Spacing (in iters) between window starts. 0 (default) == a single
+        # window: capture cons_iters from START, then stop. > 0 repeats the
+        # same-sized window every INTERVAL iters (e.g. START, START+INTERVAL,
+        # ...). The window must fit inside the interval (asserted) so windows
+        # never overlap.
+        self.interval = _env_int("CMOE_CAPTURE_INTERVAL", 0)
+        # CMOE_CAPTURE_MAX_MB: record only the first N microbatches of each captured iteration (0 = all).
+        self.max_mb = _env_int("CMOE_CAPTURE_MAX_MB", 0)
+        # Limit capture to the first N global ranks (0..N-1). 0 (default) ==
+        # all ranks. Each rank holds a different slice of the batch, so N ranks
+        # captures N/world_size of the samples per iter (fewer files & storage).
+        self.num_ranks = _env_int("CMOE_CAPTURE_NUM_RANKS", 0)
+        self.verbose = _env_flag("CMOE_CAPTURE_VERBOSE", False)
+
+        # Resolved window params, filled lazily once the global batch size is
+        # known (see _resolve_window): iters-per-window, spacing, and the total
+        # captured-iter cap (0 == unlimited).
+        self._resolved = False
+        self._win_iters = 0
+        self._win_interval = 1
+        self._win_max = 0
+
+        # Runtime state.
+        self._captured_iters = set()
+        self._active = False          # is the current forward being captured?
+        self._cur_iter = -1
+        self._mb_index = 0            # micro-batch counter within an iteration
+        self._last_seen_iter = -1
+        self._router = {}             # layer_number -> (indices, probs)
+        self._tokens = None
+        self._embeddings = None
+
+        if self.enabled and self._is_writer_rank():
+            os.makedirs(self.out_dir, exist_ok=True)
+
+    @property
+    def is_active(self) -> bool:
+        """True only during a forward pass that is being captured."""
+        return self._active
+
+    @property
+    def wants_router(self) -> bool:
+        """True when the current forward should record router decisions.
+
+        Cheap single-call guard for the hot path in ``TopKRouter.routing``.
+        """
+        return self._active and self.capture_experts
+
+    # -- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _global_rank() -> int:
+        if torch.distributed.is_available() and torch.distributed.is_initialized():
+            return torch.distributed.get_rank()
+        return 0
+
+    def _is_writer_rank(self) -> bool:
+        # Every rank writes its own file (the sequence may be sharded across
+        # CP / TP-SP ranks), so all ranks are writers.
+        return True
+
+    def _current_iteration(self) -> int:
+        try:
+            from megatron.training.global_vars import get_args
+
+            return int(getattr(get_args(), "curr_iteration", 0))
+        except Exception:
+            return 0
+
+    # -- forward-pass lifecycle -----------------------------------------
+
+    def begin_step(self, token_ids=None, input_embeddings=None):
+        """Called at the top of the model forward. Decides whether to capture
+        this forward pass and stashes token ids / embeddings if so."""
+        if not self.enabled:
+            return
+
+        it = self._current_iteration()
+
+        # Track micro-batch index within an iteration (forward is called once
+        # per micro-batch with the same curr_iteration).
+        if it != self._last_seen_iter:
+            self._last_seen_iter = it
+            self._mb_index = 0
+        else:
+            self._mb_index += 1
+
+        self._cur_iter = it
+        self._router = {}
+        self._tokens = None
+        self._embeddings = None
+
+        self._active = self._should_capture(it)
+        if not self._active:
+            return
+
+        if self.capture_tokens and token_ids is not None:
+            # input_ids is [b, s] -> matches inspect_routing token_ids [b, s].
+            self._tokens = token_ids.detach().to("cpu", torch.int32, copy=True)
+        if self.capture_embeddings and input_embeddings is not None:
+            # Megatron embeddings are [s, b, h]; inspect_routing wants [b, s, h].
+            self._embeddings = (
+                input_embeddings.detach().transpose(0, 1).to("cpu", torch.bfloat16, copy=True)
+            )
+
+    def _resolve_window(self):
+        """Resolve the consecutive-iter capture window.
+
+        cons_iters -> window of that many consecutive iters.
+          - interval == 0: a SINGLE window -> capture cons_iters consecutive
+            iters from START, then stop.
+          - interval  > 0: REPEAT that window every `interval` iters; assert the
+            window fits inside the interval so windows never overlap.
+        cons_iters == 0 -> unlimited: capture every iter from START.
+        """
+        if self._resolved:
+            return
+        self._resolved = True
+
+        self._win_iters = max(1, self.cons_iters) if self.cons_iters > 0 else 0
+
+        if self.interval > 0:
+            if self._win_iters and self._win_iters > self.interval:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"CMOE_CAPTURE: consecutive window CMOE_CAPTURE_CONS_ITERS="
+                    f"{self.cons_iters} exceeds CMOE_CAPTURE_INTERVAL={self.interval}; "
+                    f"windows would overlap. Increase the interval or reduce "
+                    f"CMOE_CAPTURE_CONS_ITERS."
+                )
+            # Repeated windows of _win_iters every `interval` iters; unlimited.
+            self._win_interval = self.interval
+            self._win_max = 0
+        else:
+            # Single consecutive window from START, then stop.
+            self._win_interval = max(1, self._win_iters)
+            self._win_max = self._win_iters  # 0 (unlimited) if cons_iters==0
+
+    def _should_capture(self, it: int) -> bool:
+        self._resolve_window()
+        # Only the first num_ranks global ranks capture (0 == all ranks).
+        if self.num_ranks > 0 and self._global_rank() >= self.num_ranks:
+            return False
+        if it < self.start_iter:
+            return False
+        # Inside the consecutive window at the start of each interval: phase
+        # 0.._win_iters-1 captures, the rest of the interval is skipped. When
+        # _win_iters == 0 (unlimited) every iter from START is captured.
+        if self._win_iters and (it - self.start_iter) % self._win_interval >= self._win_iters:
+            return False
+        if self._win_max > 0 and len(self._captured_iters) >= self._win_max:
+            return it in self._captured_iters  # allow finishing an in-flight iter
+        return True
+
+    def record_router(self, layer_number: int, indices: torch.Tensor, probs: torch.Tensor):
+        """Record per-token expert choices for one MoE layer.
+
+        ``indices`` and ``probs`` are expected with shape [b, s, top_k], where
+        slot k=0 is the top-1 (highest-scoring) expert and probs[..., k] is the
+        gate weight of the expert at indices[..., k]. ``indices`` are
+        router-local expert ids in [0, num_experts) (matching inspect_routing's
+        convention).

+        (topk over scores + expert_bias), so the biases themselves are not
+        captured here.
+        """
+        if not (self._active and self.capture_experts):
+            return
+        if self.max_mb and self._mb_index >= self.max_mb:
+            return
+        # Storage-lean, lossless capture:
+        #   - expert ids are non-negative and < num_experts, so uint8 holds
+        #     them exactly for the usual configs (<=256 experts) at half the
+        #     size of int16. Fall back to int16 beyond that.
+        #   - routing probs are kept in their NATIVE dtype (bf16 under --bf16,
+        #     matching what the model/CUDA actually computed) instead of being
+        #     cast to fp16, which would be a lossy reinterpretation for the
+        #     same byte cost.
+        idx_dtype = torch.uint8 if int(indices.max()) <= 255 else torch.int16
+        self._router[layer_number] = (
+            indices.detach().to("cpu", idx_dtype, copy=True),
+            probs.detach().to("cpu", copy=True),
+        )
+
+    def end_step(self):
+        """Called after the decoder forward. Writes the captured data to disk."""
+        if not (self.enabled and self._active):
+            return
+        if self.max_mb and self._mb_index >= self.max_mb:
+            return
+
+        payload = {
+            "iteration": self._cur_iter,
+            "micro_batch": self._mb_index,
+            "parallel": self._parallel_metadata(),
+        }
+
+        if self._tokens is not None:
+            payload["token_ids"] = self._tokens
+        if self._embeddings is not None:
+            payload["input_embeddings"] = self._embeddings
+
+        if self.capture_experts and self._router:
+            layers = sorted(self._router.keys())
+            # Stack along a new layer axis: [b, s, L_moe, top_k].
+            expert_paths = torch.stack([self._router[l][0] for l in layers], dim=-2)
+            routing_probs = torch.stack([self._router[l][1] for l in layers], dim=-2)
+            payload["moe_layer_indices"] = layers
+            payload["expert_paths"] = expert_paths
+            payload["routing_probs"] = routing_probs
+
+        rank = self._global_rank()
+        # Uniform per-(micro-batch, rank) filename so every shard is named
+        # consistently and easy to enumerate downstream (including rank0/mb0).
+        fname = f"iter_{self._cur_iter:08d}_mb{self._mb_index}_rank{rank}.pt"
+        torch.save(payload, os.path.join(self.out_dir, fname))
+
+        if self.verbose and rank == 0:
+            shape = tuple(payload["expert_paths"].shape) if "expert_paths" in payload else None
+            print(
+                f"[capture] iter={self._cur_iter} mb={self._mb_index} rank={rank} "
+                f"layers={payload.get('moe_layer_indices')} expert_paths={shape} -> {fname}",
+                flush=True,
+            )
+
+        self._captured_iters.add(self._cur_iter)
+
+        # Clear buffers.
+        self._active = False
+        self._router = {}
+        self._tokens = None
+        self._embeddings = None
+
+    def _parallel_metadata(self) -> dict:
+        try:
+            from megatron.core import parallel_state as ps
+
+            return {
+                "global_rank": self._global_rank(),
+                "tp_rank": ps.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank(),
+                "tp_size": ps.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size(),
+                "cp_rank": ps.get_context_parallel_rank(),
+                "cp_size": ps.get_context_parallel_world_size(),
+                "pp_rank": ps.get_pipeline_model_parallel_rank(),
+                "pp_size": ps.get_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size(),
+                "ep_rank": ps.get_expert_model_parallel_rank(),
+                "ep_size": ps.get_expert_model_parallel_world_size(),
+                "dp_rank": ps.get_data_parallel_rank(),
+            }
+        except Exception:
+            return {"global_rank": self._global_rank()}
+
+
+_CAPTURER = None
+
+
+def get_capturer() -> CaptureManager:
+    """Return the process-global capture manager (constructed on first use)."""
+    global _CAPTURER
+    if _CAPTURER is None:
+        _CAPTURER = CaptureManager()
+    return _CAPTURER

+"""Custom global-expert-to-EP-rank placement for the all-to-all MoE dispatcher.
+
+Ported from ROCm/Megatron-LM PR #166 ("co-activation expert placement"). The
+placement is a permutation of ``range(num_moe_experts)`` in rank-major slot
+order: reshaped to ``[ep_size, num_local_experts]``, row ``r`` lists the global
+expert ids owned by EP rank ``r`` (in local-slot order). The default
+(contiguous) placement is ``range(num_experts)``.
+
+A placement file is JSON of the form::
+
+    {"num_experts": N, "default": [perm of 0..N-1], "layers": {"<layer_number>": [perm]}}
+
+``default`` applies to every MoE layer; per-layer entries in ``layers`` (keyed by
+the global layer number) override it. Files are produced offline by
+``tools/moe_expert_placement/build_expert_placement.py`` from a route capture.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import functools
+import json
+from typing import Dict, List, Optional
+
+
+def validate_expert_placement_perm(perm, num_experts: int, ep_size: int, ctx: str) -> List[int]:
+    """Validate one placement array: a permutation of ``range(num_experts)`` that
+    reshapes cleanly to ``[ep_size, num_experts // ep_size]``."""
+    if not isinstance(perm, (list, tuple)):
+        raise ValueError(f"moe_expert_placement {ctx}: expected a list, got {type(perm)}.")
+    perm = [int(x) for x in perm]
+    if len(perm) != num_experts:
+        raise ValueError(f"moe_expert_placement {ctx}: expected {num_experts} entries, got {len(perm)}.")
+    if sorted(perm) != list(range(num_experts)):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"moe_expert_placement {ctx}: entries must be a permutation of 0..{num_experts - 1}."
+        )
+    if num_experts % ep_size != 0:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"moe_expert_placement {ctx}: num_experts ({num_experts}) must be divisible by "
+            f"expert_model_parallel_size ({ep_size})."
+        )
+    return perm
+
+
+def parse_moe_expert_placement(path: str, num_experts: Optional[int], ep_size: int) -> Dict:
+    """Load and validate a placement JSON file.
+
+    Returns ``{'default': list|None, 'layers': {int: list}}`` with validated permutations.
+    """
+    if num_experts is None:
+        raise ValueError("moe_expert_placement requires num_experts to be set.")
+    with open(path, "r") as f:
+        raw = json.load(f)
+    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
+        raise ValueError("moe_expert_placement JSON must be an object.")
+    if "num_experts" in raw and int(raw["num_experts"]) != num_experts:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"moe_expert_placement num_experts ({raw['num_experts']}) does not match "
+            f"num_experts ({num_experts})."
+        )
+    parsed: Dict = {"default": None, "layers": {}}
+    if raw.get("default") is not None:
+        parsed["default"] = validate_expert_placement_perm(raw["default"], num_experts, ep_size, "'default'")
+    for layer_key, perm in (raw.get("layers") or {}).items():
+        layer_number = int(layer_key)
+        parsed["layers"][layer_number] = validate_expert_placement_perm(
+            perm, num_experts, ep_size, f"layer {layer_number}"
+        )
+    if parsed["default"] is None and not parsed["layers"]:
+        raise ValueError("moe_expert_placement JSON must define at least a 'default' or 'layers' entry.")
+    return parsed
+
+
+@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None)
+def load_moe_expert_placement(path: str, num_experts: Optional[int], ep_size: int) -> Dict:
+    """Cached :func:`parse_moe_expert_placement`.
+
+    The parsed table has integer layer keys, so it must not be stored on the Primus
+    module params (``merge_namespace`` turns dicts into ``SimpleNamespace`` keyword
+    arguments). Callers re-load it from the path instead; the result is shared, so
+    treat it as read-only.
+    """
+    return parse_moe_expert_placement(path, num_experts, ep_size)
+
+
+def get_expert_placement_order(config, layer_number, ep_size: int) -> List[int]:
+    """Resolve the global-expert-to-EP-rank placement for a single MoE layer.
+
+    Returns a list of length ``config.num_moe_experts`` giving global expert ids in
+    rank-major slot order. ``config.moe_expert_placement`` (the parsed placement
+    table, or None) may override the contiguous default with a per-layer
+    permutation (keyed by ``layer_number``) or a global ``'default'`` permutation.
+    """
+    num_experts = config.num_moe_experts
+    placement = getattr(config, "moe_expert_placement", None)
+    if placement is None:
+        return list(range(num_experts))
+
+    order = None
+    layers = placement.get("layers") or {}
+    if layer_number is not None and layer_number in layers:
+        order = layers[layer_number]
+    elif placement.get("default") is not None:
+        order = placement["default"]
+
+    if order is None:
+        # No entry for this layer -> fall back to the default contiguous placement.
+        return list(range(num_experts))
+
+    assert len(order) == num_experts, (
+        f"moe_expert_placement for layer {layer_number} has {len(order)} entries, " f"expected {num_experts}."
+    )
+    assert (
+        num_experts % ep_size == 0
+    ), f"num_moe_experts ({num_experts}) must be divisible by expert parallel size ({ep_size})."
+    assert sorted(order) == list(
+        range(num_experts)
+    ), f"moe_expert_placement for layer {layer_number} is not a permutation of 0..{num_experts - 1}."
+    return list(order)
+
+
+def resolve_global_expert_ids(local_expert_indices, num_local_experts: int, ep_rank: int) -> List[int]:
+    """Global expert ids owned by this rank in local-slot order.
+
+    With a custom placement ``local_expert_indices`` is given (and may be
+    non-contiguous); ``None`` means the contiguous block
+    ``[ep_rank * num_local_experts, (ep_rank + 1) * num_local_experts)``.
+    """
+    if local_expert_indices is not None:
+        assert len(local_expert_indices) == num_local_experts, (
+            len(local_expert_indices),
+            num_local_experts,
+        )
+        return list(local_expert_indices)
+    offset = ep_rank * num_local_experts
+    return [offset + i for i in range(num_local_experts)]
+
+
+def compute_layer_expert_placement(config, layer_number, ep_size: int, ep_rank: int):
+    """``(expert_order, local_expert_indices)`` for one MoE layer on one EP rank."""
+    expert_order = get_expert_placement_order(config, layer_number, ep_size)
+    num_local_experts = config.num_moe_experts // ep_size
+    offset = ep_rank * num_local_experts
+    local_expert_indices = [expert_order[offset + i] for i in range(num_local_experts)]
+    return expert_order, local_expert_indices

+def dedup_payload_width(hidden_size: int, topk: int, element_size: int) -> int:
+    """Return the activation-plus-route-metadata width with RCCL-safe alignment."""
+    # Each route slot carries one exactly-representable local expert ID and one

+    payload_bytes = (hidden_size + 2 * topk) * element_size

+    def _segment_count_kernel(

+        counts_ptr,  # int32 [num_blocks, num_keys] out
+        n,
+        num_keys: tl.constexpr,
+        block: tl.constexpr,
+    ):

+        pid = tl.program_id(0)
+        offs = pid * block + tl.arange(0, block)
+        keys = tl.load(keys_ptr + offs, mask=offs < n, other=-1)

+    @triton.jit
+    def _segment_rank_kernel(

+        counts_ptr,  # int32 [num_blocks, num_keys] from _segment_count_kernel
+        rank_ptr,  # int32 [n] out: exclusive rank of each element among equal keys
+        n,

+        in array order: the block prefix from the per-block counts plus an

+        x_ptr,  # uint8 [n_rows, ncols]

+  the true global expert ids owned by this rank live in
+  ``placed_expert_indices``.
+* :class:`PrimusDedupAlltoAllTokenDispatcher` -- on top of that, one wire row per
+  unique (token, destination EP rank) instead of one per (token, expert), in
+  both the dispatch and the combine direction.
+
+The ``megatron.moe.token_dedup`` patch binds these in place of
+``MoEAlltoAllTokenDispatcher`` when ``moe_token_dedup`` or
+``moe_expert_placement`` is set; otherwise the upstream dispatcher is untouched.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from typing import List, Optional, Tuple
+
+import torch
+from megatron.core import utils
+from megatron.core.tensor_parallel import all_to_all
+from megatron.core.transformer.moe.moe_utils import ProcessGroupCollection
+from megatron.core.transformer.moe.token_dispatcher import MoEAlltoAllTokenDispatcher
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.transformer.moe.token_dedup import (
+    build_wire_recv_index,
+    build_wire_send_index,
+    dedup_payload_width,
+    expand_token_dedup_received,
+    fused_index_build_available,
+    pack_token_dedup_payload,
+    permute_token_dedup_expert_output,
+    reduce_token_dedup_expert_output,
+    restore_token_dedup_output,
+    routing_counts,
+    unpack_token_dedup_payload,
+    weighted_reduce_token_dedup_expert_output,

+
+def _compact_mask_indices(mask: torch.Tensor, count: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Return set-bit indices without ``nonzero`` or sorting.
+
+    ``count`` is already known by the caller from collective metadata, so this
+    compaction remains device-side and does not need to discover a dynamic
+    output shape.
+    """
+    if count == 0:
+        return torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.long, device=mask.device)
+    prefix = mask.reshape(-1).cumsum(0, dtype=torch.long)
+    ordinal = torch.arange(1, count + 1, dtype=torch.long, device=mask.device)
+    return torch.searchsorted(prefix, ordinal)
+
+
+def _token_destination_hit_map(
+    indices: torch.Tensor, num_local_experts: int, ep_size: int
+) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Build the sort-free token-to-destination map.
+
+    Returns destination ranks with shape ``[tokens, topk]`` and a destination
+    major boolean map with shape ``[ep_size, tokens]``. Multiple experts for one
+    token on the same destination set only one bit in the latter.
+    """
+    destinations = torch.div(indices, num_local_experts, rounding_mode="floor")
+    ep_ranks = torch.arange(ep_size, device=indices.device).view(ep_size, 1, 1)
+    hits = (destinations.unsqueeze(0) == ep_ranks).any(dim=-1)
+    return destinations, hits
+
+
+def dedup_weighted_combine_enabled(config) -> bool:
+    """Whether the dedup combine applies the routing weights itself.
+
+    Mirrors the PR's condition: experts-side weighting stays for
+    ``moe_apply_probs_on_input``, the TE op fuser, and fused weighted activations.
+    """
+    return bool(
+        getattr(config, "moe_token_dedup_weighted_combine", False)
+        and not getattr(config, "moe_apply_probs_on_input", False)
+        and not getattr(config, "use_transformer_engine_op_fuser", False)
+        and not getattr(config, "use_fused_weighted_squared_relu", False)
+        and (
+            getattr(config, "use_te_activation_func", False)
+            or not getattr(config, "bias_activation_fusion", False)
+        )
+    )

+class PrimusAlltoAllTokenDispatcher(MoEAlltoAllTokenDispatcher):
+    """Upstream all-to-all dispatcher plus a custom expert placement.
+
+    ``local_expert_indices`` passed in are the TRUE global expert ids owned by this
+    rank (possibly non-contiguous). The base class is initialised with the
+    contiguous slot block instead, because everything it does with
+    ``local_expert_indices`` (the ``preprocess`` count slice) is in slot space
+    after the column permutation applied in :meth:`dispatch_preprocess`.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        num_local_experts: int,
+        local_expert_indices: List[int],
+        config: TransformerConfig,
+        pg_collection: Optional[ProcessGroupCollection] = None,
+        expert_order: Optional[List[int]] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        ep_rank = utils.get_pg_rank(pg_collection.ep)
+        slot_indices = [ep_rank * num_local_experts + i for i in range(num_local_experts)]
+        super().__init__(
+            num_local_experts=num_local_experts,
+            local_expert_indices=slot_indices,
+            config=config,
+            pg_collection=pg_collection,
+        )
+        self.set_expert_order(
+            expert_order if expert_order is not None else list(range(self.num_experts)),
+            local_expert_indices,
+        )
+
+    def set_expert_order(self, expert_order: List[int], local_expert_indices: List[int]) -> None:
+        """(Re)configure the custom expert placement.
+
+        Called at construction and again from ``MoELayer.set_layer_number()`` once
+        the (per-layer) placement is known. Placement only permutes which global
+        expert maps to each local slot; all shapes and ``num_local_experts`` are
+        unchanged, so this is a metadata-only update.
+
+        Args:
+            expert_order: global expert ids in rank-major slot order.
+            local_expert_indices: global expert ids owned by this rank.
+        """
+        assert (
+            len(expert_order) == self.num_experts
+        ), f"expert_order has {len(expert_order)} entries, expected {self.num_experts}."
+        assert len(local_expert_indices) == self.num_local_experts, "Invalid local expert indices"
+        self.expert_order = list(expert_order)
+        self.placed_expert_indices = list(local_expert_indices)
+        # In slot space this rank always owns the contiguous block
+        # [ep_rank * num_local_experts, (ep_rank + 1) * num_local_experts).
+        self.local_slot_start = self.ep_rank * self.num_local_experts
+        self.local_slot_end = self.local_slot_start + self.num_local_experts
+        assert self.local_expert_indices == list(range(self.local_slot_start, self.local_slot_end))
+        # Default contiguous placement -> no column permutation (fast path). Otherwise the
+        # gather index tensor is created lazily on the routing map's device at first use.
+        self.expert_order_is_identity = self.expert_order == list(range(self.num_experts))
+        self._expert_order_index_cache = None
+
+    def _get_expert_order_index(self, device):
+        """Lazily build/cache the column-permutation index tensor on ``device``."""
+        if self.expert_order_is_identity:
+            return None
+        cache = self._expert_order_index_cache
+        if cache is None or cache.device != device:
+            self._expert_order_index_cache = torch.tensor(self.expert_order, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
+        return self._expert_order_index_cache
+
+    def _to_slot_space(self, routing_map: torch.Tensor, probs: torch.Tensor):
+        """Permute the expert (column) axis into rank-major slot order."""
+        expert_order_index = self._get_expert_order_index(routing_map.device)
+        if expert_order_index is None:
+            return routing_map, probs
+        return (
+            routing_map.index_select(1, expert_order_index),
+            probs.index_select(1, expert_order_index),
+        )
+
+    def dispatch_preprocess(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, routing_map: torch.Tensor, probs: torch.Tensor
+    ):
+        routing_map, probs = self._to_slot_space(routing_map, probs)
+        return super().dispatch_preprocess(hidden_states, routing_map, probs)
+
+
+class PrimusDedupAlltoAllTokenDispatcher(PrimusAlltoAllTokenDispatcher):
+    """All-to-all dispatcher with one wire row per token and destination rank.
+
+    The regular alltoall dispatcher sends one hidden row for every token/expert
+    assignment. This opt-in implementation (``moe_token_dedup``) sends a hidden
+    row only once when several selected experts are on the same EP rank. A small
+    expert-id record accompanies each wire row and the receiver expands directly
+    into expert-major order. The combine direction is deduplicated too: local
+    expert outputs for the same wire row are summed to one row before the
+    combine all-to-all.
+
+    Combined with a co-activation expert placement (``moe_expert_placement``),
+    which co-locates experts that tend to fire together, the number of wire rows
+    per token drops further because more of a token's experts share a rank.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        num_local_experts: int,
+        local_expert_indices: List[int],
+        config: TransformerConfig,
+        pg_collection: Optional[ProcessGroupCollection] = None,
+        expert_order: Optional[List[int]] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(
+            num_local_experts=num_local_experts,
+            local_expert_indices=local_expert_indices,
+            config=config,
+            pg_collection=pg_collection,
+            expert_order=expert_order,
+        )
+        if self.ep_size <= 1:
+            raise ValueError("Token dedup requires expert parallel size greater than one.")
+        if self.tp_size > 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Token dedup does not support expert tensor parallelism; set "
+                "expert_tensor_parallel_size: 1."
+            )
+        if self.drop_and_pad or self.config.moe_expert_capacity_factor is not None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Token dedup currently supports dropless routing only; disable expert capacity "
+                "and expert-input padding."
+            )
+        if getattr(self.config, "moe_router_padding_for_quantization", False):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Token dedup requires exactly top-k routing rows; disable "
+                "moe_router_padding_for_quantization."
+            )
+        if getattr(self.config, "cuda_graph_impl", "none") != "none":
+            raise ValueError("Token dedup does not support CUDA graphs.")
+        if self.num_local_experts > 256:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Token dedup supports at most 256 local experts so expert IDs remain exact "
+                "when carried in a BF16 activation row."
+            )
+        self.weighted_combine = dedup_weighted_combine_enabled(self.config)
+        # Per-peer wire-row counts of the deduplicated all-to-all (host lists).
+        self.dedup_input_splits = None
+        self.dedup_output_splits = None
+        self._dedup_meta_work = None
+        self._dedup_hits = None
+        self._dedup_destinations = None
+        self._dedup_token_wire_rows = None
+        self._dedup_wire_tokens = None
+        self._dedup_wire_to_expert_rows = None
+        self._dedup_expert_wire_rows = None
+        self._dedup_wire_probs = None
+        self._dedup_num_tokens = 0
+        self._dedup_topk = 0
+
+    def _metadata_gather_launch(self, packed: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Launch the one packed metadata all-gather; do NOT touch the host.
+
+        All host values needed by the all-to-all-v interface ride one collective,
+        and the D2H is deferred to :meth:`_metadata_finish` so the local index
+        build and payload pack can overlap the gather's in-flight time.
+        """
+        gathered_all = packed.new_empty(self.ep_size * packed.numel())
+        # async_op=True so the kernels launched "during" the gather do not queue
+        # behind the collective and the peer-skew wait.
+        self._dedup_meta_work = torch.distributed.all_gather_into_tensor(
+            gathered_all, packed, group=self.ep_group, async_op=True
+        )
+        return gathered_all.view(self.ep_size, packed.numel())
+
+    def _metadata_finish(self, gathered_all: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Wait for the gather, copy metadata to the host, publish split lists."""
+        work = self._dedup_meta_work
+        self._dedup_meta_work = None
+        if work is not None:
+            work.wait()
+        counts_width = self.num_experts + self.ep_size
+        gathered = gathered_all[:, :counts_width]
+        gathered_cpu = gathered.to(torch.device("cpu"), non_blocking=False)
+        all_expert_counts_cpu = gathered_cpu[:, : self.num_experts]
+        local_expert_counts_cpu = all_expert_counts_cpu[
+            :, self.local_slot_start : self.local_slot_end
+        ].contiguous()
+        self.input_splits = (
+            all_expert_counts_cpu[self.ep_rank].view(self.ep_size, self.num_local_experts).sum(dim=1).tolist()
+        )
+        self.output_splits = local_expert_counts_cpu.sum(dim=1).tolist()
+        self.dedup_input_splits = gathered_cpu[self.ep_rank, self.num_experts : counts_width].tolist()
+        self.dedup_output_splits = gathered_cpu[:, self.num_experts + self.ep_rank].tolist()
+        self.num_global_tokens_per_local_expert_cpu = local_expert_counts_cpu
+        self.cuda_sync_point = "no_sync"
+        self.tokens_per_expert_gpu = gathered[:, self.local_slot_start : self.local_slot_end].sum(dim=0)
+        return local_expert_counts_cpu.sum(dim=0)
+
+    def _build_send_buffers(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, probs: torch.Tensor, indices: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Pack destination-major activations and route metadata without sorting.
+
+        Torch fallback for devices without the fused Triton index build.
+        """
+        num_tokens, topk = indices.shape
+        hidden_size = hidden_states.shape[-1]
+        # A wire row is wider than the activation because it carries expert IDs,
+        # routing probabilities, and alignment.
+        self.dedup_row_elems = dedup_payload_width(hidden_size, topk, hidden_states.element_size())
+        if num_tokens == 0:
+            self._dedup_num_tokens = 0
+            self._dedup_topk = topk
+            self._dedup_token_wire_rows = torch.empty((0, topk), dtype=torch.long, device=indices.device)
+            self._dedup_wire_tokens = torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.long, device=indices.device)
+            return hidden_states.new_empty((0, self.dedup_row_elems))
+        num_wire_rows = sum(self.dedup_input_splits)
+        entries = _compact_mask_indices(self._dedup_hits, num_wire_rows)
+        wire_destinations = torch.div(entries, num_tokens, rounding_mode="floor")
+        wire_tokens = entries.remainder(num_tokens)
+        token_destinations = self._dedup_destinations.index_select(0, wire_tokens)
+        token_local_experts = indices.remainder(self.num_local_experts).index_select(0, wire_tokens)
+        wire_experts = torch.where(
+            token_destinations == wire_destinations.unsqueeze(1),
+            token_local_experts,
+            token_local_experts.new_full((), -1),
+        ).to(dtype=torch.long)
+        # Retain the exact token/top-k slot for every expert assignment. These
+        # maps drive probability gradients and the final destination-partial
+        # reduction without sorting.
+        active = wire_experts >= 0
+        active_entries = _compact_mask_indices(active, sum(self.input_splits))
+        wire_token_slots = (
+            wire_tokens.unsqueeze(1) * topk + torch.arange(topk, device=indices.device).unsqueeze(0)
+        ).reshape(-1)
+        return_slots = wire_token_slots.index_select(0, active_entries)
+        wire_row_slots = (
+            torch.arange(num_wire_rows, device=indices.device).unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, topk).reshape(-1)
+        )
+        slot_wire_rows = torch.full((num_tokens * topk,), -1, dtype=torch.long, device=indices.device)
+        slot_wire_rows.index_copy_(0, return_slots, wire_row_slots.index_select(0, active_entries))
+        slot_wire_rows = slot_wire_rows.view(num_tokens, topk)
+        # One wire-row lookup per unique token/destination lets both output
+        # restoration and payload backward gather bounded rows without atomics.
+        representative_slots = active.to(dtype=torch.int8).argmax(dim=1)
+        token_wire_rows = torch.full((num_tokens * topk,), -1, dtype=torch.long, device=indices.device)
+        token_wire_rows.index_copy_(
+            0,
+            wire_tokens * topk + representative_slots,
+            torch.arange(num_wire_rows, device=indices.device),
+        )
+        token_wire_rows = token_wire_rows.view(num_tokens, topk)
+        self._dedup_num_tokens = num_tokens
+        self._dedup_topk = topk
+        self._dedup_token_wire_rows = token_wire_rows
+        self._dedup_wire_tokens = wire_tokens
+        return pack_token_dedup_payload(
+            hidden_states, probs, wire_tokens, wire_experts, token_wire_rows, slot_wire_rows
+        )
+
+    def _expand_received(self, received: torch.Tensor, received_experts: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Fan all received wire rows into expert-major order.
+
+        Also records the wire-row -> expert-row map that the deduplicated combine
+        uses to collapse the local expert outputs back to one row per wire row.
+        """
+        num_assignments = sum(self.output_splits)
+        if num_assignments == 0:
+            self._dedup_wire_to_expert_rows = torch.full_like(received_experts, -1)
+            self._dedup_expert_wire_rows = received_experts.new_empty(0)
+            return received[:0]
+        if fused_index_build_available(received.device):
+            wire_to_expert_rows, expert_wire_rows, _ = build_wire_recv_index(
+                received_experts,
+                self.tokens_per_expert_gpu,
+                num_assignments,
+                received_experts.new_zeros(received_experts.shape, dtype=received.dtype),
+            )
+            if num_assignments == received.shape[0]:
+                # No destination collisions: a permutation, gather-only backward.
+                inverse = wire_to_expert_rows.amax(dim=1)
+                expanded = permute_token_dedup_expert_output(received, expert_wire_rows, inverse)
+            else:
+                expanded = expand_token_dedup_received(received, expert_wire_rows, wire_to_expert_rows)
+            self._dedup_wire_to_expert_rows = wire_to_expert_rows
+            self._dedup_expert_wire_rows = expert_wire_rows
+            return expanded
+        flat_experts = received_experts.reshape(-1)
+        expert_ids = torch.arange(self.num_local_experts, device=received.device).unsqueeze(1)
+        expert_membership = expert_ids == flat_experts.unsqueeze(0)
+        # Compact the expert-major membership matrix. Each selected entry gives
+        # the wire row to duplicate into that expert's contiguous input region.
+        membership_entries = _compact_mask_indices(expert_membership, num_assignments)
+        flat_wire_slots = membership_entries.remainder(flat_experts.numel())
+        wire_rows = torch.div(flat_wire_slots, received_experts.shape[1], rounding_mode="floor")
+        # Expert outputs later need to collapse to wire-major rows before the
+        # deduplicated combine. Construct the inverse mapping with a scatter,
+        # not an argsort.
+        wire_rank = (flat_experts >= 0).cumsum(0, dtype=torch.long) - 1
+        expert_row_to_wire_rank = wire_rank.index_select(0, flat_wire_slots)
+        wire_to_expert_row = torch.empty_like(expert_row_to_wire_rank)
+        wire_to_expert_row.scatter_(
+            0, expert_row_to_wire_rank, torch.arange(num_assignments, device=received.device)
+        )
+        wire_to_expert_rows = torch.full_like(received_experts, -1)
+        wire_to_expert_rows.view(-1).index_copy_(
+            0, flat_wire_slots, torch.arange(num_assignments, device=received.device)
+        )
+        if num_assignments == received.shape[0]:
+            # With no destination collisions every wire row has exactly one
+            # expert row, so this is a permutation rather than a fan-out.
+            expanded = permute_token_dedup_expert_output(received, wire_rows, wire_to_expert_row)
+        else:
+            expanded = expand_token_dedup_received(received, wire_rows, wire_to_expert_rows)
+        self._dedup_wire_to_expert_rows = wire_to_expert_rows
+        self._dedup_expert_wire_rows = wire_rows
+        return expanded
+
+    def dispatch_preprocess(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, routing_map: torch.Tensor, probs: torch.Tensor
+    ):
+        """Build one wire row per unique (token, destination EP rank) pair.
+
+        The wire row carries the activation plus per-slot local expert ids and
+        routing probabilities, so no separate metadata or probability all-to-all
+        is needed.
+        """
+        self.hidden_shape = hidden_states.shape
+        assert probs.dim() == 2, "Expected 2D tensor for probs"
+        assert routing_map.dim() == 2, "Expected 2D tensor for token2expert mask"
+        assert routing_map.dtype == torch.bool, "Expected bool tensor for mask"
+        # Custom expert placement: the dedup hit map is built in slot space, so
+        # placements that co-locate co-activated experts on one rank directly
+        # increase dedup opportunities.
+        routing_map, probs = self._to_slot_space(routing_map, probs)
+        self.probs = probs
+        self.routing_map = routing_map
+        hidden_states = hidden_states.view(-1, self.hidden_shape[-1])
+        topk = self.config.moe_router_topk
+        num_tokens = routing_map.shape[0]
+        hidden_size = self.hidden_shape[-1]
+        use_fused = fused_index_build_available(routing_map.device)
+
+        if use_fused:
+            # One fused pass: expert counts | destination counts (the all-gather payload),
+            # the [tokens, ep_size] destination hit map, and its per-block partial sums.
+            packed, hits, hit_partial = routing_counts(routing_map, self.num_local_experts, self.ep_size)
+            dedup_send_counts = packed[self.num_experts :]
+            hit_block_counts, hit_block = hit_partial[:, self.num_experts :], 256
+        else:
+            # [num_experts] in slot space; equivalent to bincount but sync-free.
+            expert_counts = routing_map.sum(dim=0, dtype=torch.long)
+            # [tokens, ep_size]: does the token route to that destination rank?
+            hits = routing_map.reshape(num_tokens, self.ep_size, self.num_local_experts).any(dim=-1)
+            dedup_send_counts = hits.sum(dim=0, dtype=torch.long)
+            packed = torch.cat((expert_counts, dedup_send_counts))
+        gathered = self._metadata_gather_launch(packed)
+
+        if use_fused:
+            # Local-only GPU work sized by an upper bound (a token has at most
+            # min(topk, ep_size) wire rows), so it overlaps the metadata gather
+            # still in flight above. Only the a2a itself needs host split values.
+            max_wire_rows = num_tokens * min(topk, self.ep_size)
+            (indices, slot_wire_rows, token_wire_rows, wire_tokens_full, wire_experts_full) = (
+                build_wire_send_index(
+                    routing_map,
+                    hits,
+                    dedup_send_counts,
+                    self.num_local_experts,
+                    self.ep_size,
+                    topk,
+                    max_wire_rows,
+                    hit_block_counts=hit_block_counts,
+                    hit_block=hit_block,
+                )
+            )
+            # Differentiable slot-probability gather: routing-probability
+            # gradients flow back to the router through this op.
+            slot_probs = probs.gather(1, indices)
+        else:
+            # Torch fallback (CPU / no triton): derive fixed-width top-k indices
+            # from the dense map; slot order within a row is irrelevant as long
+            # as the probs use the same order.
+            indices = torch.topk(routing_map.int(), k=topk, dim=1).indices
+            slot_probs = probs.gather(1, indices)
+            self._dedup_destinations = torch.div(indices, self.num_local_experts, rounding_mode="floor")
+            self._dedup_destinations.masked_fill_(~routing_map.gather(1, indices), -1)
+            self._dedup_hits = hits.t()
+
+        if self.shared_experts is not None:
+            self.shared_experts.pre_forward_comm(hidden_states.view(self.hidden_shape))
+
+        self.tokens_per_expert = self._metadata_finish(gathered)
+
+        if use_fused:
+            num_wire_rows = sum(self.dedup_input_splits)
+            self.dedup_row_elems = dedup_payload_width(hidden_size, topk, hidden_states.element_size())
+            self._dedup_num_tokens = num_tokens
+            self._dedup_topk = topk
+            self._dedup_token_wire_rows = token_wire_rows

+        if self.shared_experts is not None:
+            self.shared_experts.wait_current_stream()

+            self.ep_group,
+            permutated_local_input_tokens,
+            self.dedup_output_splits,
+            self.dedup_input_splits,
+            use_nccl_stream=self.use_nccl_stream,

+        """Unpack the received payload and fan wire rows into expert-major order."""
+        hidden_size = self.hidden_shape[-1]

+        received_expert_cols = global_input_tokens[:, hidden_size : hidden_size + self._dedup_topk]
+        received_probs = global_input_tokens[
+            :, hidden_size + self._dedup_topk : hidden_size + 2 * self._dedup_topk

+            weighted = self.weighted_combine

+                expert_wire_rows,

+                expert_probs,
+                hidden_size,

+                self._dedup_wire_probs = permuted_probs

+                self._dedup_wire_probs = None

+                self.shared_experts.linear_fc1_forward_and_act(expanded)
+        else:

+            expanded = self._expand_received(received, received_experts)
+            if self.shared_experts is not None:
+                self.shared_experts.linear_fc1_forward_and_act(expanded)
+            # Weight inside the experts as the stock dispatcher does; the combine then only sums.
+            wire_rows = self._dedup_expert_wire_rows
+            rows = torch.arange(wire_rows.numel(), device=wire_rows.device).unsqueeze(1)
+            wire_slots = self._dedup_wire_to_expert_rows.index_select(0, wire_rows) == rows
+            flat_slots = wire_rows * self._dedup_topk + wire_slots.to(torch.int8).argmax(dim=1)
+            permuted_probs = received_probs.reshape(-1)[flat_slots].to(self.probs.dtype)

+        self.tokens_per_expert = None
+        if os.environ.get("NVTE_USE_GROUPED_GEMM_TRITON") == "1":
+            tokens_per_expert_gpu = self.tokens_per_expert_gpu.to(torch.int32)
+            self.tokens_per_expert_gpu = None
+            return expanded, (tokens_per_expert, tokens_per_expert_gpu), permuted_probs
+        return expanded, tokens_per_expert, permuted_probs
+
+    def combine_preprocess(self, hidden_states):
+        """Sum the local expert outputs to one row per wire row (weighted if the
+        experts skipped the routing-weight multiply)."""
+        if self._dedup_wire_probs is not None:
+            return weighted_reduce_token_dedup_expert_output(
+                hidden_states, self._dedup_wire_to_expert_rows, self._dedup_wire_probs
+            )
+        return reduce_token_dedup_expert_output(
+            hidden_states, self._dedup_expert_wire_rows, self._dedup_wire_to_expert_rows
+        )
+
+    def token_combine(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        async_finish: bool = True,
+        allocate_on_comm_stream: bool = True,
+    ):
+        """Deduplicated combine all-to-all: one row per wire row."""
+        if self.shared_experts is not None:
+            self.shared_experts.wait_current_stream()
+        return all_to_all(
+            self.ep_group,
+            hidden_states,
+            self.dedup_input_splits,
+            self.dedup_output_splits,
+            use_nccl_stream=self.use_nccl_stream,
+        )
+
+    def combine_postprocess(self, permutated_local_input_tokens):
+        """Scatter returned wire rows back to token order and restore the input shape."""
+        if self.shared_experts is not None:
+            self.shared_experts.linear_fc2_forward(permutated_local_input_tokens)
+            self.shared_experts.post_forward_comm()
+        output = restore_token_dedup_output(
+            permutated_local_input_tokens, self._dedup_token_wire_rows, self._dedup_wire_tokens
+        )
+        output = output.view(self.hidden_shape)
+        # Autograd functions saved the tensors needed by backward. Drop the
+        # dispatcher's extra references now so route maps and the received
+        # payload view do not stay live beyond this forward.
+        self._dedup_token_wire_rows = None
+        self._dedup_wire_tokens = None
+        self._dedup_wire_to_expert_rows = None
+        self._dedup_expert_wire_rows = None
+        self._dedup_wire_probs = None
+        self._dedup_destinations = None
+        self._dedup_hits = None
+        if self.shared_experts is not None:
+            output += self.shared_experts.get_output()
+        return output
+
+
+def build_alltoall_token_dispatcher(
+    num_local_experts: int,
+    local_expert_indices: List[int],
+    config: TransformerConfig = None,
+    pg_collection: Optional[ProcessGroupCollection] = None,
+    **kwargs,
+):
+    """Drop-in replacement for the ``MoEAlltoAllTokenDispatcher`` constructor call in
+    ``MoELayer.__init__``: the dedup dispatcher when ``moe_token_dedup`` is on
+    (and EP > 1, where there is something to dedup), else the placement-capable
+    stock dispatcher."""
+    use_dedup = bool(getattr(config, "moe_token_dedup", False)) and utils.get_pg_size(pg_collection.ep) > 1
+    cls = PrimusDedupAlltoAllTokenDispatcher if use_dedup else PrimusAlltoAllTokenDispatcher
+    return cls(num_local_experts, local_expert_indices, config=config, pg_collection=pg_collection, **kwargs)

+"""Checkpoint expert-axis keys under a custom expert placement (PR #166 port).
+
+Megatron-core keys distributed-checkpoint expert tensors by global expert id,
+computed as ``ep_rank * num_local_experts + local_slot``. With
+``moe_expert_placement`` the global ids a rank owns are no longer that
+contiguous block, so the three places that derive the id are rewritten to read
+the ``local_expert_indices`` attribute the ``megatron.moe.token_dedup`` patch
+records on the experts module and its grouped-linear children:
+
+* ``TEGroupedMLP.sharded_state_dict`` (the swiglu fc1 factory offsets),
+* ``SequentialMLP.sharded_state_dict``,
+* ``TEGroupedLinear._sharded_state_dict_grouped`` (also used by
+  ``PrimusTurboGroupedLinear``).
+
+Checkpoints therefore stay keyed by global expert id: a run may load a
+checkpoint saved with a different placement (weights are reshuffled to the new
+owners by the sharded load). Positional optimizer formats are NOT remapped, so
+``load_checkpoint`` warns when a distributed-optimizer state is loaded under a
+placement, and a legacy ``torch`` checkpoint (rank-local layout) is refused
+unless it was saved with the same placement.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.patches._patch_guard import is_patched, mark_patched
+from primus.backends.megatron.patches._source_patch_utils import patch_method_source_multi
+from primus.core.patches import PatchContext, get_args, register_patch
+from primus.core.utils.module_utils import log_rank_0, warning_rank_0
+
+_PREFIX = "[Patch:megatron.moe.expert_placement_checkpoint]"
+_KEY = "megatron.moe.expert_placement_checkpoint"
+
+
+def _placement_enabled(ctx: PatchContext) -> bool:
+    return bool(getattr(get_args(ctx), "moe_expert_placement", None))
+
+
+_MLP_ANCHOR_OFFSET = "local_expert_indices_offset = self.ep_group.rank() * self.num_local_experts"
+_MLP_REPLACE_OFFSET = (
+    "global_expert_ids = resolve_global_expert_ids("
+    "getattr(self, 'local_expert_indices', None), self.num_local_experts, self.ep_group.rank())"
+)
+_TE_ANCHOR_OFFSET = "local_expert_indices_offset = get_pg_rank(self._pg_collection.ep) * self.num_gemms"
+_TE_REPLACE_OFFSET = (
+    "global_expert_ids = resolve_global_expert_ids("
+    "getattr(self, 'local_expert_indices', None), self.num_gemms, get_pg_rank(self._pg_collection.ep))"
+)
+
+
+def _rewrite_expert_keys() -> None:
+    from megatron.core.extensions import transformer_engine as te_mod
+    from megatron.core.transformer.moe import experts as experts_mod
+
+    from primus.backends.megatron.core.transformer.moe.expert_placement import resolve_global_expert_ids
+
+    # A method can only be source-rewritten once (inspect cannot read an exec'd function).
+    if is_patched(experts_mod.TEGroupedMLP, _KEY):
+        return
+    mark_patched(experts_mod.TEGroupedMLP, _KEY)
+
+    # The rewritten methods are exec'd with their module's globals.
+    experts_mod.resolve_global_expert_ids = resolve_global_expert_ids
+    te_mod.resolve_global_expert_ids = resolve_global_expert_ids
+
+    patch_method_source_multi(
+        experts_mod.TEGroupedMLP,
+        "sharded_state_dict",
+        [
+            (_MLP_ANCHOR_OFFSET, _MLP_REPLACE_OFFSET),
+            (
+                "(ep_axis, local_expert_indices_offset + i, num_global_experts)",
+                "(ep_axis, global_expert_ids[i], num_global_experts)",
+            ),
+        ],
+    )
+    log_rank_0(f"{_PREFIX} Rewrote TEGroupedMLP.sharded_state_dict expert-axis offsets")
+
+    patch_method_source_multi(
+        experts_mod.SequentialMLP,
+        "sharded_state_dict",
+        [
+            (_MLP_ANCHOR_OFFSET, _MLP_REPLACE_OFFSET),
+            (
+                "expert_global_idx = local_expert_indices_offset + expert_local_idx",
+                "expert_global_idx = global_expert_ids[expert_local_idx]",
+            ),
+        ],
+    )
+    log_rank_0(f"{_PREFIX} Rewrote SequentialMLP.sharded_state_dict expert-axis offsets")
+
+    te_grouped_linear = getattr(te_mod, "TEGroupedLinear", None)
+    if te_grouped_linear is None:
+        warning_rank_0(f"{_PREFIX} TEGroupedLinear not available; grouped-GEMM checkpoint keys not patched")
+        return
+    patch_method_source_multi(
+        te_grouped_linear,
+        "_sharded_state_dict_grouped",
+        [
+            (_TE_ANCHOR_OFFSET, _TE_REPLACE_OFFSET),
+            (
+                "global_expert_idx = local_expert_indices_offset + gemm_idx",
+                "global_expert_idx = global_expert_ids[gemm_idx]",
+            ),
+        ],
+    )
+    log_rank_0(f"{_PREFIX} Rewrote TEGroupedLinear._sharded_state_dict_grouped expert-axis offsets")
+
+
+def _check_legacy_checkpoint_placement(args) -> None:
+    """Refuse a legacy ``torch`` checkpoint saved under another placement.
+
+    Legacy checkpoints store expert weights by local EP rank/slot, so loading them
+    under a different placement would assign the tensors to different global
+    experts. Mirrors ``_check_legacy_checkpoint_expert_placement`` in PR #166.
+    """
+    from megatron.training import checkpointing as ckpt_mod
+
+    if getattr(args, "ckpt_format", "torch_dist") != "torch" or getattr(
+        args, "auto_detect_ckpt_format", False
+    ):
+        return
+    load_dir = getattr(args, "load", None)
+    if not load_dir or not ckpt_mod.checkpoint_exists(load_dir):
+        return
+    requested_path = getattr(args, "moe_expert_placement", None)
+    state_dict, _, _, ckpt_type = ckpt_mod._load_base_checkpoint(load_dir, args, rank0=True)
+    if state_dict is None or ckpt_type != ckpt_mod.CheckpointType.LEGACY:
+        return
+    checkpoint_args = state_dict.get("args", None)
+    saved_path = getattr(checkpoint_args, "moe_expert_placement", None) or None
+    if saved_path is not None and requested_path:
+        if os.path.abspath(saved_path) == os.path.abspath(requested_path):
+            return
+        # Different paths may still hold the same placement.
+        try:
+            from primus.backends.megatron.core.transformer.moe.expert_placement import (
+                load_moe_expert_placement,
+            )
+
+            num_experts = getattr(args, "num_experts", None)
+            ep_size = int(getattr(args, "expert_model_parallel_size", 1) or 1)
+            if load_moe_expert_placement(saved_path, num_experts, ep_size) == load_moe_expert_placement(
+                requested_path, num_experts, ep_size
+            ):
+                return
+        except (OSError, ValueError):
+            pass
+    raise RuntimeError(
+        "Cannot safely load a legacy torch checkpoint with a different moe_expert_placement. "
+        "Legacy torch checkpoints store expert weights by local EP rank/slot, so changing "
+        "placement at load time assigns those tensors to different global experts and can "
+        "diverge loss. Load this checkpoint with its original placement, then save a new "
+        "checkpoint with ckpt_format: torch_dist before changing expert placement. "
+        f"Checkpoint placement: {saved_path if saved_path is not None else '<none>'}; "
+        f"requested placement: {requested_path}."
+    )
+
+
+def _wrap_load_checkpoint() -> None:
+    from megatron.training import checkpointing as ckpt_mod
+    from megatron.training.global_vars import get_args as get_megatron_args
+
+    from primus.backends.megatron.patches._rebind import rebind_everywhere
+
+    if is_patched(ckpt_mod, _KEY):
+        return
+    orig_load_checkpoint = ckpt_mod.load_checkpoint
+
+    def load_checkpoint(ddp_model, optimizer, opt_param_scheduler, *a, **kw):
+        args = get_megatron_args()
+        if getattr(args, "moe_expert_placement", None):
+            _check_legacy_checkpoint_placement(args)
+            if not getattr(args, "no_load_optim", False) and getattr(
+                args, "use_distributed_optimizer", False
+            ):
+                warning_rank_0(
+                    f"{_PREFIX} loading distributed-optimizer state with a custom moe_expert_placement. "
+                    "Positional optimizer formats restore fp32 main params and Adam moments by buffer "
+                    "position, NOT by global expert id -- correct ONLY if this checkpoint was saved with "
+                    "the SAME placement. Resuming a differently-placed checkpoint corrupts the model on "
+                    "the first step; use no_load_optim: true in that case."
+                )
+        return orig_load_checkpoint(ddp_model, optimizer, opt_param_scheduler, *a, **kw)
+
+    rebound = rebind_everywhere(ckpt_mod, "load_checkpoint", load_checkpoint)
+    mark_patched(ckpt_mod, _KEY)
+    log_rank_0(
+        f"{_PREFIX} Wrapped load_checkpoint (legacy-format placement check, dist-opt warning) in {rebound}"
+    )
+
+
+@register_patch(
+    _KEY,
+    backend="megatron",
+    phase="before_train",
+    description=(
+        "Key distributed-checkpoint expert tensors by the placed global expert id "
+        "(TEGroupedMLP / SequentialMLP / TEGroupedLinear) and guard legacy-format loads "
+        "under moe_expert_placement"
+    ),
+    condition=_placement_enabled,
+)
+def patch_expert_placement_checkpoint(ctx: PatchContext):
+    del ctx
+    _rewrite_expert_keys()
+    _wrap_load_checkpoint()

+
+Env-var gated (``CMOE_CAPTURE=1``; see ``primus/backends/megatron/core/capture.py``
+for the full list). When active, every forward records each MoE layer's top-k
+expert choices and gate weights per token and writes one ``.pt`` shard per
+(iteration, micro-batch, rank) to ``CMOE_CAPTURE_DIR``.
+``tools/moe_expert_placement/build_expert_placement.py`` turns those shards into
+a placement JSON for ``moe_expert_placement``.
+
+Instead of editing ``GPTModel.forward`` and the router (as the upstream PR does),
+this wraps:
+
+* ``GPTModel.forward`` -- ``begin_step`` / ``end_step`` around the decoder, and
+* ``TopKRouter.forward`` -- derives the dense ``[tokens, topk]`` selection from
+  the returned sparse ``probs`` / ``routing_map`` and records it.
+
+The derived selection is ordered by gate weight, which is the ordering the
+placement builder uses (``_winner_first``). Padding-masked tokens record a zero
+weight; token dropping is not supported by the capture (it is not supported by
+token dedup either).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.patches._patch_guard import is_patched, mark_patched
+from primus.core.patches import PatchContext, register_patch
+from primus.core.utils.module_utils import log_rank_0
+
+_PREFIX = "[Patch:megatron.moe.route_capture]"
+_KEY = "megatron.moe.route_capture"
+
+
+def _capture_requested(ctx: PatchContext) -> bool:
+    del ctx
+    return os.environ.get("CMOE_CAPTURE", "").strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "yes", "on")
+
+
+def _wrap_gpt_forward() -> None:
+    from megatron.core.models.gpt import gpt_model as gpt_mod
+
+    from primus.backends.megatron.core.capture import get_capturer
+
+    cls = gpt_mod.GPTModel
+    if is_patched(cls, _KEY):
+        return
+    orig_forward = cls.forward
+
+    def forward(self, input_ids, position_ids, attention_mask, decoder_input=None, *a, **kw):
+        capturer = get_capturer()
+        # Embeddings are only captured with CMOE_CAPTURE_EMBEDDINGS; the decoder input is
+        # usually computed inside forward, so only an explicitly passed one is recorded.
+        capturer.begin_step(token_ids=input_ids, input_embeddings=decoder_input)
+        try:
+            return orig_forward(self, input_ids, position_ids, attention_mask, decoder_input, *a, **kw)
+        finally:
+            capturer.end_step()
+
+    cls.forward = forward
+    mark_patched(cls, _KEY)
+    log_rank_0(f"{_PREFIX} Wrapped GPTModel.forward with route-capture begin_step/end_step")
+
+
+def _wrap_router_forward() -> None:
+    import torch
+    from megatron.core.transformer.moe import router as router_mod
+
+    from primus.backends.megatron.core.capture import get_capturer
+
+    cls = router_mod.TopKRouter
+    if is_patched(cls, _KEY):
+        return
+    orig_forward = cls.forward
+
+    def forward(self, input, *a, **kw):
+        probs, routing_map = orig_forward(self, input, *a, **kw)
+        capturer = get_capturer()
+        if capturer.wants_router and getattr(self, "routing_type", None) != "sinkhorn":
+            seq_length, bsz = input.shape[:2]
+            topk = self.topk
+            # Selected experts first (routing_map), then by gate weight: slot 0 is the
+            # highest-weight expert, as the capture format expects.
+            key = probs.detach().float() + routing_map.to(torch.float32)
+            top_indices = torch.topk(key, k=topk, dim=1).indices
+            top_probs = torch.gather(probs.detach(), 1, top_indices)
+            layer_number = self.layer_number if self.layer_number is not None else 0
+            if getattr(self, "is_mtp_layer", False):
+                layer_number = layer_number + self.config.num_layers
+            capturer.record_router(
+                int(layer_number),
+                top_indices.view(seq_length, bsz, topk).transpose(0, 1),
+                top_probs.view(seq_length, bsz, topk).transpose(0, 1),
+            )
+        return probs, routing_map
+
+    cls.forward = forward
+    mark_patched(cls, _KEY)
+    log_rank_0(f"{_PREFIX} Wrapped TopKRouter.forward to record per-token expert choices")
+
+
+@register_patch(
+    _KEY,
+    backend="megatron",
+    phase="before_train",
+    description="Record MoE routing decisions to disk when CMOE_CAPTURE=1 (input for build_expert_placement.py)",
+    condition=_capture_requested,
+)

+    del ctx
+    from primus.backends.megatron.core.capture import get_capturer
+
+    capturer = get_capturer()
+    os.makedirs(capturer.out_dir, exist_ok=True)
+    _wrap_gpt_forward()
+    _wrap_router_forward()
+    log_rank_0(
+        f"{_PREFIX} capture dir={capturer.out_dir} start={capturer.start_iter} "
+        f"cons_iters={capturer.cons_iters} interval={capturer.interval}"
+    )

+    """Make ``cls.forward`` accept ``permuted_probs=None`` by substituting unit weights.

+"""Co-activation-based expert placement -> expert_placement_per_layer.json (offline tool).
+
+Uses *within-layer* co-activation, read from route captures written by
+``megatron/core/capture.py`` (CMOE_CAPTURE=1), to decide for each MoE layer which
+experts should be **co-located on the same EP rank**; the runtime consumes the
+result through ``--moe-expert-placement`` (parsed in megatron/training/arguments.py,
+applied in megatron/core/transformer/moe/moe_layer.py).
+
+Why co-locate co-activated experts
+----------------------------------
+``coactivation[L][e1, e2] = P(e2 in top-k | e1 in top-k)`` (the notebook's
+within-layer measure).  When a token's top-k experts live on the SAME device the
+dispatch all-to-all sends that token to one rank instead of several, so grouping
+frequently co-selected experts onto one rank shrinks EP communication.  We treat
+the symmetric co-selection count matrix as an affinity graph and partition the
+experts into ``ep_size`` equal-size groups that maximise intra-group weight; each
+group becomes one rank's contiguous slot block.
+
+Output (consumed by ``--moe-expert-placement-path``)
+----------------------------------------------------
+``_parse_moe_expert_placement`` expects an object with a rank-major permutation
+of ``0..num_experts-1`` under ``default`` and/or per-layer under ``layers``,
+keyed by the model ``layer_number``::
+
+    {
+      "num_experts": 128,
+      "default": [ ...perm... ],                 # fallback for uncaptured layers
+      "layers": { "3": [ ...perm... ], "7": [...] }   # key = moe_layer_indices[m]
+    }
+
+This is a pure-CPU offline tool (numpy + torch, no ``megatron`` import):
+    python tools/build_expert_placement.py $CAPTURE_DIR \
+        --iters 2000-2009 --num-experts 128 --ep-size 8 \
+        --out expert_placement_per_layer.json
+"""

+import os
+from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

+import numpy as np
+import torch
